title: Workflow Documentation Port to Codex Plugin
gradingCriteria: Rejects the copied claim that Workflow is built into Codex or directly invoked by the model; describes the CLI script execution model instead.
Accurately states where run artifacts live and which files are stable enough to document publicly.
Explains progress observation through `agent-workflows watch` or MCP resources without promising a native Claude Code-style UI tree.
Describes resume as content-addressed journal replay with same-script cache hits and independent-call reuse, not strict unchanged-prefix replay.
Provides replacement public wording in stable target-state form rather than patch-style language about what changed from Claude.
Keeps the README focused on public CLI behavior, run files, and user-visible guarantees, while leaving implementation internals or comparative fidelity details to separate docs.
